newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Electronics in China CDMA deal.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Electronics in China CDMA deal.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co, an affiliate of South Korea's Samsung Group, said it has been selected as the official code division multiple access (CDMA) hardware provider for the city of Shanghai.

The company said in a statement that the turnkey contract calls for Samsung to provide China Shanghai Changcheng Mobile Communications Co Ltd with a switching station that has the capacity to handle 68,000 subscribers. The deal also includes 67 base stations and follow-up services.
An official in Samsung's public relations department in Seoul said the value of the contract could not be disclosed.
Installation will begin in the first half of this year, and the system will be fully operational within the second half, the official said.
